title: Repository environment ladder governance
purpose: Record discovery-only Dev, Test, and Staging ladder policies for promotion decisions, rollback and retry, human acceptance, and environment-specific non-claims.

authorityBoundary.notes: This artifact closes design criteria only. It does not create staging implementation, deployment, live-provider proof, human acceptance evidence, or readiness claims.

baselineSemantics: Dev, Test, and Staging are separate environment proof positions and must not upgrade each other by implication.
Provider mode and environment are separate dimensions.
Hermetic mock does not satisfy live external provider proof.
Production shaped does not satisfy production live.
Generated reports remain lower authority than raw evidence and semantic definitions.
Ambiguity, stale evidence, unknown status, or missing evidence fails closed to fuller validation.

environmentPromotionDecisionMatrix.assuranceImpact: A promotion matrix prevents both under-proofing risky changes and making staging proof the default for ordinary docs, semantic, validator, or Dev/Test work.

changeClasses.minimumProof: strict parse where applicable plus authority-reference review; no staging proof by default
strict JSON parse, catalogue consistency, schema-authoring checks, and relevant validators
validator selftest or planted-defect expectation before implementation; before-after equivalence for implementation
Test or Compose proof as scoped; staging only when staging-relevant surfaces are affected

changeClasses.class: public proof, provider integration, deployment, human acceptance, or production-shaped rehearsal
changeClasses.minimumProof: staging-relevant gate and owner review before claim
pre-UI readiness gates plus environment/provider/proof mapping before implementation

environmentPromotionDecisionMatrix.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must encode change-class routing and fall back to fuller validation when a change class is unknown, mixed, or authority-impacting.

rollbackAndRetryPolicy.assuranceImpact: Rollback and retry policy prevents reruns from masking stale evidence, partial failure, or environment mismatch.
policyRules: Retry may only reuse evidence when source inputs, provider mode, environment, proof level, and freshness state still match.
Rollback must preserve failed evidence or failure references when the failure affects a proof or promotion decision.
Unknown retry cause, missing raw evidence, changed inputs, or environment/provider mismatch requires a clean rerun of the relevant fuller gate.
Rollback from staging-relevant rehearsal does not create a staging pass; it records recovery evidence for later review.
Owner review is required when rollback or retry changes the claim boundary, evidence freshness, or promotion decision.
rollbackAndRetryPolicy.validationProofExpectation: Future validators should fail closed on stale retry evidence, missing failure references, mismatched provider mode, mismatched environment, and missing rollback owner metadata.

humanAcceptanceRequiredProofPolicy.assuranceImpact: Human acceptance is required only for human-review, proof-cockpit, public proof, staging-relevant, or owner-decision surfaces; it must not become a default substitute for validators.
requiredWhen: A change affects human review actions, proof-cockpit acceptance, screenshots, public FQDN proof, staging rehearsal, deployment-adjacent evidence, or owner-decision semantics.
A validator or generated report identifies ambiguity that cannot be resolved by machine evidence alone.
Acceptance requires interpreting screenshots, UI flows, public proof evidence, incident response evidence, privacy/security evidence, or release/rollback rehearsal evidence.
notRequiredWhen: The change is documentation-only and has no human-acceptance semantics.
The change is semantic or JSON-only and all required validators parse and pass within their authority scope.
The change is Dev or Test scoped and has no public, staging, deployment, human-review, or proof-cockpit acceptance surface.
humanAcceptanceRequiredProofPolicy.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must preserve machine validation as the default and require owner or human review only for classified human-acceptance surfaces or ambiguity.

environmentSpecificNonClaims.assuranceImpact: Explicit non-claims prevent lower-environment evidence from being read as stronger proof or readiness.
nonClaims: Dev evidence is not Test evidence unless a Dev-to-Test handoff gate explicitly permits reuse.
Test evidence is not Staging evidence and does not by itself support staging readiness.

Staging rehearsal evidence is not deployment approval, production readiness, production-live proof, compliance certification, store readiness, or human acceptance unless separately proven and approved.
Hermetic mock proof is not live external provider proof.
Production-shaped proof is not production-live proof.
Generated reports are not canonical authority and cannot upgrade proof status without retained raw evidence.
Unknown, stale, or missing evidence is not pass evidence.
environmentSpecificNonClaims.validationProofExpectation: Future validators and reports must preserve these non-claims in generated output, aggregate summaries, artifact handoffs, and readiness-adjacent language.
